photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

creditsUsed.description: The number of credits the user has used.

creditsTotal.description: The total number of credits available to the user.

List.title: List
List.description: Represents a user's cleaned email list.

name.description: The name of the list file.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the list was created.

emailCount.description: Total number of emails in the list.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns the list.

data.description: The full dataset of the list, with each object being a row.

NewsletterSubscriber.title: Newsletter Subscriber
NewsletterSubscriber.description: Represents an email address subscribed to the newsletter.

subscribedAt.description: Timestamp of when the user subscribed.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information, including subscription and credit details.

/users/{userId}/lists/{listId}.description: Stores the cleaned email lists for each user.

/subscribers/{subscriberId}.description: Stores email addresses for the newsletter.
